findings.title: Sharon Regional Health System suspends hospital services; emergency department unavailable from November 4
findings.publisher: Sharon Regional Health System (Tenor Health Foundation)
findings.exact_supporting_passage: emergency department services will not be available to the public as of November 4, 2026 at 7:00 p.m.
findings.service_line: Emergency department; hospital acute care and outpatient operations; inpatient services previously paused October 29
findings.access_consequences: Sharon Regional states its emergency department became unavailable to the public at 7:00 p.m. Eastern on November 4, 2026. Hospital acute-care and outpatient operations are being suspended. Patients requiring inpatient care will be stabilized and transferred to an appropriate facility. Other reporting says remaining hospital operations close to the public by 8 a.m. Eastern on November 6; the official website's directly confirmed ED effective time is prioritized.
findings.affected_population: Emergency and hospital-care patients in Sharon, Mercer County, and the Shenango Valley, Pennsylvania; number affected not established

source_verification.primary_note: The hospital's current official website states immediate service suspension and ED unavailability beginning November 4 at 7:00 p.m.; page carries no explicit publication date.
source_verification.discrepancy: Becker's reports acute/outpatient/ED public closure beginning November 6 at 8 a.m.; the hospital's currently displayed official notice sets ED unavailability on November 4 at 7 p.m. Direct primary notice controls the ED effective date. A staggered broader shutdown may explain the difference, but that is not independently resolved.
